summary: current-composition-local.py --source-built copies the checked-out commit (git archive) under a private root, packs FS.GG.Workspace.Template there with the Coordination Python fixture revision the source names (taken from a local clone, never fetched), and runs the typed cases against that package with the same public Rendering archives and locked graph. A second typed plan, source-built-composition-plan, differs from the published plan only by a template section that pins no archive and by two source-only cases. The summary records source commit, tree, ancestry of the local origin/main ref, package bytes and SHA-256; the verdict is dom-observed-source-built-reference-only, never published or installed. First run of the unchanged nine cases: 27/27 on the 0.20.0 source package. Closing the two gaps recorded in templates/published-payload-and-example-composition-4818: (a) a FourD Encounter options island (labelled select, checkbox, Camera radio group) beside the Encounter note, presentation-only, created once and only its status line rewritten on retained updates; (b) a focus and native editing/IME survival case. Both new cases failed on the commit before the implementation (2 failed, 9 passed), pass 11/11 per browser in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (33 total) after it, and four scratch regressions (note recreated on session replacement, island re-rendered on a retained update, focus stolen on replacement or on an update) each fail both. The case that fails before the change fails because the island nodes do not exist; its note, caret and composition assertions pass by nature and are shown to discriminate by the regressions. They are not in the published 0.19.3 archive, so they reach users with the next Workspace.Template release. Cross-lane note: scripts/svg-current-reference-adoption.json pins allowed canonical digests per managed path to the published 0.19.3 source and its pure control copies the checkout as a synthetic candidate; changing a managed template file therefore needs the successor digest added (done here for two-client.spec.ts, FourDReference.fs and the FourD README, keeping the published digest), and real adoption runs authenticate published receivers, so they still match the old digest. Evidence limits: IME is synthetic composition events; installed receiver, durable save (#4819), AT (#4817) and published acceptance are separate.
title: Source-built mode runs the typed DOM cases against Workspace.Template packed from the checkout; two new panel and focus cases pass 33/33 there only
